name: Employees
description: Track employee time, bill customers for billable hours and run payroll, with time pulled from timesheet.io.

fields.label: Currency
fields.help: Pay rates, billing rates, billings and pay runs are all in this currency.

fields.label: Wages expense account code
fields.help: Debited with gross pay when a pay run is posted. Can also be chosen when posting.

fields.label: Employer payroll cost account code
fields.help: Expense account for the employer's share (pension, insurance, payroll taxes).

fields.label: Payroll liabilities account code
fields.help: Liability account credited with amounts withheld from pay plus the employer's share, until they are remitted.

fields.label: Billable hours account code
fields.help: Debited for each billed time entry, with the customer on the transaction (an asset account, e.g. 1250 Unbilled billable hours). Add it under Settings → Sales → Billable items so Sales offers the hours on the customer's next invoice.

fields.label: Revenue account for billed hours
fields.help: Credited for each billed time entry.

fields.label: timesheet.io API key
fields.help: Create one at my.timesheet.io → Development → API keys. It looks like ts_xxxx.yyyy. Time is synced both ways: changes made in Ledger are sent to timesheet.io and win.

fields.label: Time zone for time sent to timesheet.io
fields.help: For time entered in Ledger, which starts at 9:00 there, e.g. America/Toronto. Empty: UTC.

fields.label: Days of time to pull from timesheet.io
fields.help: Each sync re-reads this many days back, so edits made in timesheet.io are picked up.

fields.label: Pull from timesheet.io when someone signs in to Ledger
